faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Common questions

items.question: Can I switch plans at any time?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, and we'll prorate the cost accordingly.

items.question: What happens after the 5-day trial?
items.answer: After your 5-day trial ends, you'll be automatically charged based on your selected plan and billing period. You can cancel anytime during the trial without being charged.

items.question: Is my health data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. All plans include enterprise-grade encryption, secure data storage, and compliance with HIPAA regulations. Your health data is never shared with third parties without your explicit consent.

items.question: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
items.answer: Yes! Annual billing saves you approximately 17% compared to monthly payments. You'll see the discounted price when you select yearly billing above.
